issues.title: Queue pressure without panic
issues.subject: Northstar #1 — Queue pressure without panic
issues.body: Three practical ways to keep a small operating queue legible: bound work in progress, make ownership visible, and treat retries as state rather than duplicate work. Demo issue; all source notes are fictional.

issues.title: Handoffs that survive reopen
issues.subject: Northstar #2 — Handoffs that survive reopen
issues.body: A useful handoff records the object, owner, next action, and source revision. Reopening should reconstruct the same decision without relying on browser memory. Demo issue; all source notes are fictional.

issues.title: Retries are a data model
issues.subject: Northstar #3 — Retries are a data model
issues.body: Idempotency starts with stable operation identity. Persist what already happened, then make a retry choose continuation rather than repetition. Demo issue; all source notes are fictional.
